<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷.۳ Configuration نمونه: User<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Entities.Security;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class UserConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>User<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>User<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> builder)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        builder.ToTable("Users");</span>
<span>        builder.HasKey(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Id);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Username).HasMaxLength(100).IsRequired();</span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.PasswordHash).HasMaxLength(500).IsRequired();</span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.SecurityStamp).HasMaxLength(100);</span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.FullName).HasMaxLength(200).IsRequired();</span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.PersonnelCode).HasMaxLength(50);</span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.NationalCode).HasMaxLength(10);</span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Email).HasMaxLength(200);</span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Mobile).HasMaxLength(20);</span>
<span>        builder.Property(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.LastLoginIp).HasMaxLength(45);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        builder.HasIndex(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Username).IsUnique().HasFilter("[IsDeleted] = 0");</span>
<span>        builder.HasIndex(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.PersonnelCode);</span>
<span>        builder.HasIndex(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.DepartmentId);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        builder.HasOne(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Department)</span>
<span>               .WithMany(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> d.Users)</span>
<span>               .HasForeignKey(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.DepartmentId)</span>
<span>               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // Global Query Filter</span>
<span>        builder.HasQueryFilter(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> !x.IsDeleted);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نکات مهم:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>ToTable("Users")<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>: نام دقیق جدول در SQL<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>HasMaxLength<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>: اندازه‌ی ستون‌ها<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>IsUnique().HasFilter("[IsDeleted] = 0")<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>: Unique فقط برای رکوردهای حذف‌نشده<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>HasQueryFilter<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>: رکوردهای Soft Deleted خودکار مخفی میشن<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷.۴ PasswordHasher<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مسیر:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Infrastructure/Services/PasswordHasher.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class PasswordHasher</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly IPasswordHasher<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>string<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _hasher;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public PasswordHasher()</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _hasher = new PasswordHasher<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>string<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(</span>
<span>            new Microsoft.Extensions.Options.OptionsWrapper<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>PasswordHasherOptions<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(</span>
<span>                new PasswordHasherOptions</span>
<span>                {</span>
<span>                    IterationCount = 100_000,</span>
<span>                    CompatibilityMode = PasswordHasherCompatibilityMode.IdentityV3</span>
<span>                }));</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public string Hash(string password)</span>
<span>        =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _hasher.HashPassword(string.Empty, password);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public bool Verify(string hashedPassword, string providedPassword)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var result = _hasher.VerifyHashedPassword(string.Empty, hashedPassword, providedPassword);</span>
<span>        return result == PasswordVerificationResult.Success</span>
<span>            || result == PasswordVerificationResult.SuccessRehashNeeded;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نکته:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> از <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.PasswordHasher<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> استفاده می‌کنه که PBKDF2 با 100,000 iteration پیاده می‌کنه.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷.۵ AuthService<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مسیر:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Infrastructure/Services/AuthService.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Auth.DTOs;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Entities.Security;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class AuthService : IAuthService</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private const int MaxFailedAttempts = 5;</span>
<span>    private const int LockoutMinutes = 15;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span>    private readonly PasswordHasher _passwordHasher;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public AuthService(ApplicationDbContext db, PasswordHasher passwordHasher)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>        _passwordHasher = passwordHasher;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>LoginResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> LoginAsync(string username, string password, string? ipAddress, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var user = await _db.Users</span>
<span>            .IgnoreQueryFilters()</span>
<span>            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Username == username <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> !u.IsDeleted, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (user == null)</span>
<span>            return LoginResult.Fail("نام کاربری یا رمز عبور اشتباه است");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!user.IsActive)</span>
<span>            return LoginResult.Fail("حساب کاربری شما غیرفعال است");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (user.IsLockedOut <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> user.LockoutEnd.HasValue <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> user.LockoutEnd.Value <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> DateTime.UtcNow)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var remaining = (int)Math.Ceiling((user.LockoutEnd.Value - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalMinutes);</span>
<span>            return LoginResult.Fail($"حساب شما به دلیل تلاش‌های ناموفق قفل شده است. {remaining} دقیقه دیگر دوباره تلاش کنید");</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!_passwordHasher.Verify(user.PasswordHash, password))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            user.AccessFailedCount++;</span>
<span>            if (user.AccessFailedCount <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>= MaxFailedAttempts)</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                user.IsLockedOut = true;</span>
<span>                user.LockoutEnd = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(LockoutMinutes);</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span></span>
<span>            _db.AuditLogs.Add(new AuditLog</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                UserId = user.Id,</span>
<span>                Username = user.Username,</span>
<span>                Action = "LoginFailed",</span>
<span>                IpAddress = ipAddress,</span>
<span>                IsSuccess = false,</span>
<span>                ErrorMessage = "رمز عبور اشتباه"</span>
<span>            });</span>
<span></span>
<span>            await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>            if (user.IsLockedOut)</span>
<span>                return LoginResult.Fail($"حساب شما به دلیل {MaxFailedAttempts} تلاش ناموفق، {LockoutMinutes} دقیقه قفل شد");</span>
<span></span>
<span>            return LoginResult.Fail("نام کاربری یا رمز عبور اشتباه است");</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        user.AccessFailedCount = 0;</span>
<span>        user.IsLockedOut = false;</span>
<span>        user.LockoutEnd = null;</span>
<span>        user.LastLoginAt = DateTime.UtcNow;</span>
<span>        user.LastLoginIp = ipAddress;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        _db.AuditLogs.Add(new AuditLog</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            UserId = user.Id,</span>
<span>            Username = user.Username,</span>
<span>            Action = "LoginSuccess",</span>
<span>            IpAddress = ipAddress,</span>
<span>            IsSuccess = true</span>
<span>        });</span>
<span></span>
<span>        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return LoginResult.Ok(user.Id, user.Username, user.FullName, user.MustChangePassword);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>bool<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ChangePasswordAsync(int userId, string currentPassword, string newPassword, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var user = await _db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Id == userId, ct);</span>
<span>        if (user == null) return false;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!_passwordHasher.Verify(user.PasswordHash, currentPassword))</span>
<span>            return false;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        user.PasswordHash = _passwordHasher.Hash(newPassword);</span>
<span>        user.MustChangePassword = false;</span>
<span>        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span>        return true;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetUserRoleIdsAsync(int userId, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        return await _db.UserRoles</span>
<span>            .Where(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Select(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.RoleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷.۶ PermissionService (قلب سیستم)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مسیر:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Infrastructure/Services/PermissionService.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Permissions.DTOs;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class PermissionService : IPermissionService</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private const string CacheKeyPrefix = "UserPerms_";</span>
<span>    private static readonly TimeSpan CacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span>    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public PermissionService(ApplicationDbContext db, IMemoryCache cache)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>        _cache = cache;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>UserPermissionsDto<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetUserPermissionsAsync(int userId, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var cacheKey = $"{CacheKeyPrefix}{userId}";</span>
<span>        if (_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out UserPermissionsDto? cached) <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> cached != null)</span>
<span>            return cached;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var dto = new UserPermissionsDto { UserId = userId };</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 1) نقش‌های کاربر</span>
<span>        var roleIds = await _db.UserRoles</span>
<span>            .Where(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Select(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.RoleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 2) دسترسی مستقیم کاربر به ماژول‌ها</span>
<span>        var userModuleIds = await _db.UserModuleAccesses</span>
<span>            .Where(uma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> uma.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Select(uma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> uma.ModuleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 3) دسترسی نقش‌ها به ماژول‌ها</span>
<span>        var roleModuleIds = await _db.RoleModuleAccesses</span>
<span>            .Where(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> roleIds.Contains(rma.RoleId))</span>
<span>            .Select(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rma.ModuleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var mid in userModuleIds.Concat(roleModuleIds).Distinct())</span>
<span>            dto.AccessibleModuleIds.Add(mid);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 4) دسترسی مستقیم کاربر به فرم‌ها</span>
<span>        var userPerms = await _db.UserFormPermissions</span>
<span>            .Where(ufp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufp.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Include(ufp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufp.Form)</span>
<span>            .Include(ufp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufp.Permission)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // اول Deny، بعد Grant</span>
<span>        foreach (var up in userPerms.Where(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> !x.IsGranted))</span>
<span>            dto.Permissions.Remove($"{up.Form.Code}:{up.Permission.Code}");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var up in userPerms.Where(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.IsGranted))</span>
<span>            dto.Permissions.Add($"{up.Form.Code}:{up.Permission.Code}");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 5) دسترسی نقش‌ها به فرم‌ها</span>
<span>        var rolePerms = await _db.RoleFormPermissions</span>
<span>            .Where(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> roleIds.Contains(rfp.RoleId))</span>
<span>            .Include(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.Form)</span>
<span>            .Include(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.Permission)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var rp in rolePerms)</span>
<span>            dto.Permissions.Add($"{rp.Form.Code}:{rp.Permission.Code}");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 6) Data Scope</span>
<span>        var userScopes = await _db.UserFormDataScopes</span>
<span>            .Where(ufds =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufds.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Include(ufds =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufds.Form)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var us in userScopes)</span>
<span>            dto.DataScopes[us.Form.Code] = (byte)us.Scope;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var roleScopes = await _db.RoleFormDataScopes</span>
<span>            .Where(rfds =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> roleIds.Contains(rfds.RoleId))</span>
<span>            .Include(rfds =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfds.Form)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var rs in roleScopes)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var code = rs.Form.Code;</span>
<span>            var scope = (byte)rs.Scope;</span>
<span>            if (!dto.DataScopes.ContainsKey(code) || dto.DataScopes[code] <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span> scope)</span>
<span>                dto.DataScopes[code] = scope;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        _cache.Set(cacheKey, dto, CacheDuration);</span>
<span>        return dto;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>bool<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> HasPermissionAsync(int userId, string formCode, string permissionCode, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var perms = await GetUserPermissionsAsync(userId, ct);</span>
<span>        return perms.HasPermission(formCode, permissionCode);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>bool<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> HasModuleAccessAsync(int userId, int moduleId, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var perms = await GetUserPermissionsAsync(userId, ct);</span>
<span>        return perms.HasModuleAccess(moduleId);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public Task InvalidateCacheAsync(int userId)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _cache.Remove($"{CacheKeyPrefix}{userId}");</span>
<span>        return Task.CompletedTask;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>section-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>منطق تصمیم‌گیری دسترسی:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ol</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Deny صریح کاربر → <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>رد<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Grant صریح کاربر → <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>قبول<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اتحاد دسترسی‌های نقش‌ها → <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>قبول<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>وگرنه → <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>رد<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ol</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷.۷ ApplicationDbSeeder<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مسیر:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Infrastructure/Persistence/Seed/ApplicationDbSeeder.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Entities.Security;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seed;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public static class ApplicationDbSeeder</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public static async Task SeedAsync(ApplicationDbContext db)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        // 1) Permissions</span>
<span>        if (!await db.Permissions.AnyAsync())</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            db.Permissions.AddRange(</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "View",    DisplayName = "مشاهده",       SortOrder = 1 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Create",  DisplayName = "ایجاد",         SortOrder = 2 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Edit",    DisplayName = "ویرایش",        SortOrder = 3 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Delete",  DisplayName = "حذف",           SortOrder = 4 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Print",   DisplayName = "چاپ",           SortOrder = 5 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Export",  DisplayName = "خروجی اکسل",   SortOrder = 6 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Approve", DisplayName = "تایید",         SortOrder = 7 }</span>
<span>            );</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 2) Modules</span>
<span>        if (!await db.Modules.AnyAsync())</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            db.Modules.AddRange(</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "Production", Name = "Production", DisplayName = "تولید",         SortOrder = 1 },</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "Warehouse",  Name = "Warehouse",  DisplayName = "انبار",         SortOrder = 2 },</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "QC",         Name = "QC",         DisplayName = "کنترل کیفیت",   SortOrder = 3 },</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "Sales",      Name = "Sales",      DisplayName = "فروش",         SortOrder = 4 },</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "Admin",      Name = "Admin",      DisplayName = "مدیریت سیستم",  SortOrder = 99 }</span>
<span>            );</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 3) Forms</span>
<span>        if (!await db.Forms.AnyAsync())</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var adminModule = await db.Modules.FirstAsync(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.Code == "Admin");</span>
<span></span>
<span>            db.Forms.AddRange(</span>
<span>                new Form { ModuleId = adminModule.Id, Code = "Users",       DisplayName = "مدیریت کاربران",     ControllerName = "Users",       ShowInMenu = true, SortOrder = 1 },</span>
<span>                new Form { ModuleId = adminModule.Id, Code = "Roles",       DisplayName = "مدیریت نقش‌ها",       ControllerName = "Roles",       ShowInMenu = true, SortOrder = 2 },</span>
<span>                new Form { ModuleId = adminModule.Id, Code = "Permissions", DisplayName = "مدیریت دسترسی‌ها",   ControllerName = "Permissions", ShowInMenu = true, SortOrder = 3 }</span>
<span>            );</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 4) Administrator Role</span>
<span>        var adminRole = await db.Roles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(r =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> r.Name == "Administrator");</span>
<span>        if (adminRole == null)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            adminRole = new Role</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                Name = "Administrator",</span>
<span>                DisplayName = "مدیر سیستم",</span>
<span>                Description = "دسترسی کامل به همه بخش‌ها",</span>
<span>                IsSystemRole = true,</span>
<span>                IsActive = true</span>
<span>            };</span>
<span>            db.Roles.Add(adminRole);</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 5) Role Module Access (همه ماژول‌ها برای admin)</span>
<span>        if (!await db.RoleModuleAccesses.AnyAsync(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rma.RoleId == adminRole.Id))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var allModules = await db.Modules.ToListAsync();</span>
<span>            foreach (var module in allModules)</span>
<span>                db.RoleModuleAccesses.Add(new RoleModuleAccess { RoleId = adminRole.Id, ModuleId = module.Id });</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 6) Role Form Permissions (همه دسترسی‌ها برای admin)</span>
<span>        if (!await db.RoleFormPermissions.AnyAsync(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.RoleId == adminRole.Id))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var allForms = await db.Forms.ToListAsync();</span>
<span>            var allPermissions = await db.Permissions.ToListAsync();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            foreach (var form in allForms)</span>
<span>                foreach (var perm in allPermissions)</span>
<span>                    db.RoleFormPermissions.Add(new RoleFormPermission</span>
<span>                    {</span>
<span>                        RoleId = adminRole.Id,</span>
<span>                        FormId = form.Id,</span>
<span>                        PermissionId = perm.Id</span>
<span>                    });</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 7) Admin User</span>
<span>        var adminUser = await db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Username == "admin");</span>
<span>        if (adminUser == null)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var hasher = new PasswordHasher();</span>
<span>            adminUser = new User</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                Username = "admin",</span>
<span>                PasswordHash = hasher.Hash("Admin@123"),</span>
<span>                FullName = "مدیر سیستم",</span>
<span>                IsActive = true,</span>
<span>                MustChangePassword = false</span>
<span>            };</span>
<span>            db.Users.Add(adminUser);</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            db.UserRoles.Add(new UserRole { UserId = adminUser.Id, RoleId = adminRole.Id });</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token comment">&lt;!-- ================= SECTION 8 ================= --&gt;</span></span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Authorization;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class PermissionAuthorizationHandler : AuthorizationHandler<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>PermissionRequirement<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly IPermissionService _permissionService;</span>
<span>    private readonly ICurrentUserService _currentUser;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public PermissionAuthorizationHandler(</span>
<span>        IPermissionService permissionService,</span>
<span>        ICurrentUserService currentUser)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _permissionService = permissionService;</span>
<span>        _currentUser = currentUser;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    protected override async Task HandleRequirementAsync(</span>
<span>        AuthorizationHandlerContext context,</span>
<span>        PermissionRequirement requirement)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (!_currentUser.IsAuthenticated || _currentUser.UserId is null)</span>
<span>            return;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var has = await _permissionService.HasPermissionAsync(</span>
<span>            _currentUser.UserId.Value,</span>
<span>            requirement.FormCode,</span>
<span>            requirement.PermissionCode);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (has)</span>
<span>            context.Succeed(requirement);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h3</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۸.۲.۴ PermissionPolicyProvider<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h3</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Authorization;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class PermissionPolicyProvider : IAuthorizationPolicyProvider</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly DefaultAuthorizationPolicyProvider _fallback;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public PermissionPolicyProvider(IOptions<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationOptions<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> options)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _fallback = new DefaultAuthorizationPolicyProvider(options);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationPolicy<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetDefaultPolicyAsync() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _fallback.GetDefaultPolicyAsync();</span>
<span>    public Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationPolicy?<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetFallbackPolicyAsync() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _fallback.GetFallbackPolicyAsync();</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationPolicy?<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetPolicyAsync(string policyName)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (policyName.StartsWith(HasPermissionAttribute.PolicyPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var parts = policyName[HasPermissionAttribute.PolicyPrefix.Length..].Split(':');</span>
<span>            if (parts.Length == 2)</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                var policy = new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder()</span>
<span>                    .RequireAuthenticatedUser()</span>
<span>                    .AddRequirements(new PermissionRequirement(parts[0], parts[1]))</span>
<span>                    .Build();</span>
<span></span>
<span>                return Task.FromResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationPolicy?<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(policy);</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return _fallback.GetPolicyAsync(policyName);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۸.۳ CurrentUserService<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using System.Security.Claims;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class CurrentUserService : ICurrentUserService</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;</span>
<span>    private List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>? _roleIds;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public CurrentUserService(IHttpContextAccessor httpContextAccessor)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _httpContextAccessor = httpContextAccessor;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private ClaimsPrincipal? User =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public int? UserId</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        get</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var id = User?.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);</span>
<span>            return int.TryParse(id, out var userId) ? userId : null;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public string? Username =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> User?.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.Name);</span>
<span>    public string? FullName =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> User?.FindFirstValue("FullName");</span>
<span>    public bool IsAuthenticated =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public IReadOnlyList<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> RoleIds</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        get</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            if (_roleIds != null) return _roleIds;</span>
<span></span>
<span>            var roleClaims = User?.FindAll("RoleId") ?? Enumerable.Empty<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>Claim<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>            _roleIds = roleClaims</span>
<span>                .Select(c =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> int.TryParse(c.Value, out var id) ? id : 0)</span>
<span>                .Where(id =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> id <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> 0)</span>
<span>                .Distinct()</span>
<span>                .ToList();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            return _roleIds;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۸.۴ AccountController<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using System.Security.Claims;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Web.Models.Account;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Controllers;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class AccountController : Controller</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly IAuthService _authService;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public AccountController(IAuthService authService)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _authService = authService;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public IActionResult Login(string? returnUrl = null)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)</span>
<span>            return RedirectToAction("Index", "Home");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return View(new LoginViewModel { ReturnUrl = returnUrl });</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpPost]</span>
<span>    [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Login(LoginViewModel model, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (!ModelState.IsValid)</span>
<span>            return View(model);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var ipAddress = HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString();</span>
<span>        var result = await _authService.LoginAsync(model.Username, model.Password, ipAddress, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!result.Success)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, result.ErrorMessage ?? "خطای ناشناخته");</span>
<span>            return View(model);</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var roleIds = await _authService.GetUserRoleIdsAsync(result.UserId!.Value, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var claims = new List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>Claim<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            new(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, result.UserId!.Value.ToString()),</span>
<span>            new(ClaimTypes.Name, result.Username!),</span>
<span>            new("FullName", result.FullName ?? ""),</span>
<span>            new("MustChangePassword", result.MustChangePassword.ToString())</span>
<span>        };</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var roleId in roleIds)</span>
<span>            claims.Add(new Claim("RoleId", roleId.ToString()));</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);</span>
<span>        var principal = new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        await HttpContext.SignInAsync(</span>
<span>            CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,</span>
<span>            principal,</span>
<span>            new AuthenticationProperties</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                IsPersistent = model.RememberMe,</span>
<span>                ExpiresUtc = model.RememberMe</span>
<span>                    ? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddDays(30)</span>
<span>                    : DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddHours(8)</span>
<span>            });</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (result.MustChangePassword)</span>
<span>            return RedirectToAction("ChangePassword");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.ReturnUrl) <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> Url.IsLocalUrl(model.ReturnUrl))</span>
<span>            return Redirect(model.ReturnUrl);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return RedirectToAction("Index", "Home");</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpPost]</span>
<span>    [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Logout()</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        await HttpContext.SignOutAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);</span>
<span>        return RedirectToAction("Login");</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public IActionResult AccessDenied() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> View();</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public IActionResult ChangePassword() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Content("صفحه تغییر رمز — به‌زودی");</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۸.۵ UsersController<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Entities.Security;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Web.Authorization;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Web.Models.Users;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Controllers;</span>

<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Edit(UserCreateEditViewModel vm, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (vm.Id == null) return BadRequest();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var user = await _db.Users</span>
<span>            .Include(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.UserRoles)</span>
<span>            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Id == vm.Id.Value, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (user == null) return NotFound();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (await _db.Users.AnyAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Username == vm.Username <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> u.Id != user.Id, ct))</span>
<span>            ModelState.AddModelError(nameof(vm.Username), "این نام کاربری قبلاً استفاده شده است");</span>
<span></span>

<span>        user.Username = vm.Username.Trim();</span>
<span>        user.FullName = vm.FullName.Trim();</span>
<span>        user.PersonnelCode = vm.PersonnelCode?.Trim();</span>
<span>        user.NationalCode = vm.NationalCode?.Trim();</span>
<span>        user.Email = vm.Email?.Trim();</span>
<span>        user.Mobile = vm.Mobile?.Trim();</span>
<span>        user.DepartmentId = vm.DepartmentId;</span>
<span>        user.IsActive = vm.IsActive;</span>

<span>        user.MustChangePassword = vm.MustChangePassword;</span>

<span>        var currentRoleIds = user.UserRoles.Select(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.RoleId).ToList();</span>

<span>        _db.UserRoles.RemoveRange(toRemove);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var toAdd = newRoleIds.Where(rid =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> !currentRoleIds.Contains(rid)).ToList();</span>
<span>        foreach (var rid in toAdd)</span>

<span>public class RolesController : Controller</span>
<span>{</span>

<span></span>

<span>            .Select(g =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new { RoleId = g.Key, Count = g.Count() })</span>
<span>            .ToDictionaryAsync(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.RoleId, x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Count, ct);</span>

<span></span>
<span>    [HasPermission("Roles", "Create")]</span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public IActionResult Create() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> View(new RoleEditViewModel());</span>

<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (vm.Id == null) return BadRequest();</span>

<span></span>
<span>        var modules = await _db.Modules</span>
<span>            .Where(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.IsActive)</span>
<span>            .OrderBy(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.SortOrder)</span>
<span>            .Include(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.Forms.Where(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> f.IsActive).OrderBy(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> f.SortOrder))</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var roleFormPerms = await _db.RoleFormPermissions</span>
<span>            .Where(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.RoleId == roleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var roleModuleAccesses = await _db.RoleModuleAccesses</span>
<span>            .Where(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rma.RoleId == roleId)</span>
<span>            .Select(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rma.ModuleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var module in modules)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var group = new ModuleGroup</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                ModuleId = module.Id,</span>
<span>                ModuleDisplayName = module.DisplayName</span>
<span>            };</span>
<span></span>
<span>            foreach (var form in module.Forms)</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                group.Forms.Add(new FormRow</span>
<span>                {</span>
<span>                    FormId = form.Id,</span>
<span>                    FormCode = form.Code,</span>
<span>                    FormDisplayName = form.DisplayName,</span>
<span>                    GrantedPermissionIds = roleFormPerms</span>
<span>                        .Where(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.FormId == form.Id)</span>
<span>                        .Select(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.PermissionId)</span>
<span>                        .ToHashSet()</span>
<span>                });</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span></span>
<span>            if (group.Forms.Any())</span>
<span>                vm.Modules.Add(group);</span>
<span></span>
<span>            vm.ModuleAccesses.Add(new ModuleAccessItem</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                ModuleId = module.Id,</span>
<span>                ModuleDisplayName = module.DisplayName,</span>
<span>                HasAccess = roleModuleAccesses.Contains(module.Id)</span>
<span>            });</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return View(vm);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HasPermission("Permissions", "Edit")]</span>
<span>    [HttpPost]</span>
<span>    [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Matrix(PermissionMatrixViewModel vm, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var role = await _db.Roles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(r =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> r.Id == vm.RoleId, ct);</span>
<span>        if (role == null) return NotFound();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // پاک کردن دسترسی‌های قبلی</span>
<span>        var existingFormPerms = await _db.RoleFormPermissions</span>
<span>            .Where(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.RoleId == vm.RoleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span>        _db.RoleFormPermissions.RemoveRange(existingFormPerms);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var existingModuleAccesses = await _db.RoleModuleAccesses</span>
<span>            .Where(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rma.RoleId == vm.RoleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span>        _db.RoleModuleAccesses.RemoveRange(existingModuleAccesses);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // خواندن چک‌باکس‌های تیک‌خورده: perm_{formId}_{permissionId}</span>
<span>        var form = Request.Form;</span>
<span>        var allForms = await _db.Forms.Where(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> f.IsActive).ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var formEntity in allForms)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var permIdsForThisForm = form.Keys</span>
<span>                .Where(k =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> k.StartsWith($"perm_{formEntity.Id}_"))</span>
<span>                .Select(k =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> k.Split('_').Last())</span>
<span>                .Where(v =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> int.TryParse(v, out _))</span>
<span>                .Select(int.Parse)</span>
<span>                .Distinct()</span>
<span>                .ToList();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            foreach (var permId in permIdsForThisForm)</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                _db.RoleFormPermissions.Add(new RoleFormPermission</span>
<span>                {</span>
<span>                    RoleId = vm.RoleId,</span>
<span>                    FormId = formEntity.Id,</span>
<span>                    PermissionId = permId</span>
<span>                });</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // خواندن ماژول اکسس‌ها: module_{moduleId}</span>
<span>        var allModules = await _db.Modules.Where(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.IsActive).ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span>        foreach (var module in allModules)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            if (form.ContainsKey($"module_{module.Id}"))</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                _db.RoleModuleAccesses.Add(new RoleModuleAccess</span>
<span>                {</span>
<span>                    RoleId = vm.RoleId,</span>
<span>                    ModuleId = module.Id</span>
<span>                });</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        TempData["Success"] = $"دسترسی‌های نقش «{role.DisplayName}» با موفقیت ذخیره شد";</span>
<span>        return RedirectToAction(nameof(Matrix), new { roleId = vm.RoleId });</span>
<span>    }</span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۸.۸ SidebarMenuViewComponent<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>

<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.ViewComponents;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class SidebarMenuViewComponent : ViewComponent</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span>    private readonly ICurrentUserService _currentUser;</span>
<span>    private readonly IPermissionService _permissionService;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public SidebarMenuViewComponent(</span>
<span>        ApplicationDbContext db,</span>
<span>        ICurrentUserService currentUser,</span>
<span>        IPermissionService permissionService)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>        _currentUser = currentUser;</span>
<span>        _permissionService = permissionService;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IViewComponentResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> InvokeAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (!_currentUser.IsAuthenticated || _currentUser.UserId == null)</span>
<span>            return Content(string.Empty);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var userPerms = await _permissionService.GetUserPermissionsAsync(_currentUser.UserId.Value, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var modules = await _db.Modules</span>
<span>            .Where(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.IsActive)</span>
<span>            .OrderBy(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.SortOrder)</span>
<span>            .Include(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.Forms.Where(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> f.IsActive <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> f.ShowInMenu).OrderBy(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> f.SortOrder))</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var accessibleModules = modules</span>
<span>            .Where(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> userPerms.HasModuleAccess(m.Id))</span>
<span>            .Select(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new SidebarModuleDto</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                DisplayName = m.DisplayName,</span>
<span>                Forms = m.Forms</span>
<span>                    .Where(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> userPerms.HasPermission(f.Code, "View"))</span>
<span>                    .Select(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new SidebarFormDto</span>
<span>                    {</span>
<span>                        DisplayName = f.DisplayName,</span>
<span>                        ControllerName = f.ControllerName,</span>
<span>                        ActionName = f.ActionName</span>
<span>                    })</span>
<span>                    .ToList()</span>
<span>            })</span>
<span>            .Where(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.Forms.Any())</span>
<span>            .ToList();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return View(accessibleModules);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}</span>

<span>    public List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>SidebarFormDto<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Forms { get; set; } = new();</span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h1</span> <span class="token attr-name">id</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>section-9<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۹. سیستم احراز هویت<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h1</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۹.۱ جریان ورود (Login Flow)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>1. کاربر وارد /Account/Login می‌شه</span>
<span>2. فرم Login رو پر می‌کنه (Username, Password, RememberMe)</span>
<span>3. POST به /Account/Login</span>
<span>4. AccountController.Login:</span>
<span>   ↓</span>
<span>   a. IAuthService.LoginAsync(username, password, ipAddress)</span>
<span>   ↓</span>
<span>   b. AuthService:</span>
<span>      - User رو از دیتابیس می‌خونه (IgnoreQueryFilters برای Soft Delete)</span>
<span>      - IsActive رو چک می‌کنه</span>
<span>      - IsLockedOut و LockoutEnd رو چک می‌کنه</span>
<span>      - PasswordHasher.Verify رو صدا می‌زنه</span>
<span>      - اگه رمز اشتباه:</span>
<span>        - AccessFailedCount++</span>
<span>        - اگه به MaxFailedAttempts (5) رسید → قفل 15 دقیقه</span>
<span>        - AuditLog ثبت می‌کنه</span>
<span>        - LoginResult.Fail برمی‌گردونه</span>
<span>      - اگه موفق:</span>
<span>        - AccessFailedCount = 0</span>
<span>        - IsLockedOut = false</span>
<span>        - LastLoginAt = Now</span>
<span>        - AuditLog ثبت می‌کنه</span>
<span>        - LoginResult.Ok برمی‌گردونه</span>
<span>   ↓</span>
<span>   c. GetUserRoleIdsAsync(userId)</span>
<span>   ↓</span>
<span>   d. ساخت Claims:</span>
<span>      - NameIdentifier = UserId</span>
<span>      - Name = Username</span>
<span>      - FullName = FullName</span>
<span>      - MustChangePassword = bool</span>
<span>      - RoleId = هر نقش (Multiple Claims)</span>
<span>   ↓</span>
<span>   e. HttpContext.SignInAsync(Cookie, principal, properties)</span>
<span>      - IsPersistent = RememberMe</span>
<span>      - ExpiresUtc = 30 روز یا 8 ساعت</span>
<span>   ↓</span>
<span>   f. اگه MustChangePassword → Redirect به /Account/ChangePassword</span>
<span>      وگرنه → Redirect به ReturnUrl یا /Home/Index<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
