<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>ExpireTimeSpan<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>: 8 ساعت<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>SlidingExpiration<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>: true (تمدید خودکار)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>LoginPath<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>: <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>/Account/Login<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>LogoutPath<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>: <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>/Account/Logout<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>1. admin وارد /Users می‌شه</span>
<span>2. روی «کاربر جدید» کلیک می‌کنه</span>
<span>3. فرم Create باز می‌شه (UserCreateEditViewModel)</span>
<span>4. admin فرم رو پر می‌کنه:</span>
<span>   - Username, Password, FullName, ...</span>
<span>   - نقش‌ها رو تیک می‌زنه</span>
<span>5. POST /Users/Create</span>
<span>6. UsersController:</span>
<span>   - چک یکتایی Username</span>
<span>   - Hash پسورد</span>
<span>   - ساخت User</span>
<span>   - Save</span>
<span>   - اضافه کردن UserRole ها</span>
<span>   - Save</span>
<span>   - TempData["Success"]</span>
<span>   - Redirect به /Users<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۱۱.۲ ثبت دسترسی برای یک نقش<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>1. admin وارد /Permissions می‌شه</span>
<span>2. روی «مدیریت دسترسی‌ها» کنار یک نقش کلیک می‌کنه</span>
<span>3. Matrix باز می‌شه:</span>
<span>   - کلیدهای switch برای ماژول‌ها</span>
<span>   - جدول چک‌باکس (فرم × دسترسی)</span>
<span>4. admin تنظیم می‌کنه</span>
<span>5. POST /Permissions/Matrix</span>
<span>6. PermissionsController:</span>
<span>   - پاک کردن RoleFormPermissions قبلی</span>
<span>   - پاک کردن RoleModuleAccesses قبلی</span>
<span>   - خواندن Request.Form برای perm_{formId}_{permId}</span>
<span>   - خواندن Request.Form برای module_{moduleId}</span>
<span>   - درج رکوردهای جدید</span>
<span>   - Save</span>
<span>   - TempData["Success"]</span>
<span>   - Redirect به /Permissions/Matrix (دوباره)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نکته:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> بعد از ذخیره، چون کش ۵ دقیقه‌ست، کاربر باید Logout/Login کنه یا App Restart بشه.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۱۱.۳ نمایش منوی داینامیک برای کاربر<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>1. کاربر لاگین می‌کنه</span>
<span>2. _Layout.cshtml: @await Component.InvokeAsync("SidebarMenu")</span>
<span>3. SidebarMenuViewComponent.InvokeAsync:</span>
<span>   - ICurrentUserService.UserId رو می‌گیره</span>
<span>   - IPermissionService.GetUserPermissionsAsync رو صدا می‌زنه</span>
<span>   - همه ماژول‌ها + فرم‌ها رو می‌خونه</span>
<span>   - فیلتر می‌کنه:</span>
<span>     - فقط ماژول‌هایی که userPerms.HasModuleAccess</span>
<span>     - فقط فرم‌هایی که userPerms.HasPermission(formCode, "View")</span>
<span>   - برمی‌گردونه به View</span>
<span>4. View: منوی فیلترشده رو رندر می‌کنه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  }</span>
<span>  h2 {</span>
<span>    border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0;</span>
<span>    padding-bottom: 10px;</span>
<span>    font-size: 24px;</span>
<span>    color: #2980b9;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  h3 { font-size: 20px; color: #16a085; }</span>
<span>  h4 { font-size: 17px; color: #8e44ad; }</span>
<span>  h5 { font-size: 15px; color: #c0392b; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  p { margin: 12px 0; }</span>
<span>  ul, ol { padding-right: 30px; margin: 15px 0; }</span>
<span>  li { margin: 8px 0; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  code {</span>
<span>    background: #ecf0f1;</span>
<span>    color: #c0392b;</span>
<span>    padding: 2px 6px;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 4px;</span>
<span>    font-family: 'Consolas', 'Monaco', 'Courier New', monospace;</span>
<span>    font-size: 13px;</span>
<span>    direction: ltr;</span>
<span>    display: inline-block;</span>
<span>    unicode-bidi: embed;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  /* ===== Code Block Wrapper ===== */</span>
<span>  .code-wrapper {</span>
<span>    position: relative;</span>
<span>    margin: 20px 0;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .code-header {</span>
<span>    background: #1e2a38;</span>
<span>    color: #95a5a6;</span>
<span>    padding: 8px 15px;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;</span>
<span>    display: flex;</span>
<span>    justify-content: space-between;</span>
<span>    align-items: center;</span>
<span>    font-family: 'Consolas', monospace;</span>
<span>    font-size: 12px;</span>
<span>    direction: ltr;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .code-header .lang-label {</span>
<span>    color: #3498db;</span>
<span>    font-weight: bold;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .copy-btn {</span>
<span>    background: #3498db;</span>
<span>    color: white;</span>
<span>    border: none;</span>
<span>    padding: 5px 12px;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 5px;</span>
<span>    cursor: pointer;</span>
<span>    font-family: 'Vazirmatn', Tahoma, sans-serif;</span>
<span>    font-size: 12px;</span>
<span>    transition: all 0.2s;</span>
<span>    display: inline-flex;</span>
<span>    align-items: center;</span>
<span>    gap: 5px;</span>
<span>    direction: rtl;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .copy-btn:hover {</span>
<span>    background: #2980b9;</span>
<span>    transform: translateY(-1px);</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .copy-btn.copied {</span>
<span>    background: #27ae60;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  .code-wrapper pre {</span>
<span>    margin: 0;</span>
<span>    background: #2c3e50;</span>
<span>    color: #ecf0f1;</span>
<span>    padding: 20px;</span>
<span>    border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;</span>
<span>    overflow-x: auto;</span>
<span>    direction: ltr;</span>
<span>    text-align: left;</span>
<span>    font-family: 'Consolas', 'Monaco', 'Courier New', monospace;</span>
<span>    font-size: 13px;</span>
<span>    line-height: 1.5;</span>
<span>    border-left: 4px solid #3498db;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  pre code {</span>
<span>    background: transparent;</span>
<span>    color: inherit;</span>
<span>    padding: 0;</span>
<span>    font-size: inherit;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  table {</span>
<span>    width: 100%;</span>
<span>    border-collapse: collapse;</span>
<span>    margin: 20px 0;</span>

<span>  }</span>
<span>  th, td {</span>

<span>  th {</span>
<span>    background: #34495e;</span>
<span>    color: white;</span>

<span>    font-size: 14px;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span>  tr:hover { background: #f8f9fa; }</span>
<span>  tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  blockquote {</span>
<span>    border-right: 4px solid #3498db;</span>
<span>    background: #ecf0f1;</span>

<span></span>
<span>  .toc {</span>

<span>  .toc h2 { border: none; margin-top: 0; color: #2980b9; }</span>
<span>  .toc ol { padding-right: 25px; }</span>

<span>  .badge-success { background: #27ae60; }</span>
<span>  .badge-warning { background: #f39c12; }</span>

<span>  .badge-danger { background: #e74c3c; }</span>

<span>  /* ===== Simple Explanation Box ===== */</span>

<span>  }</span>
<span></span>

<span>  }</span>
<span></span>

<span>  a { color: #3498db; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .file-tree {</span>

<span>  /* ===== Back to top button ===== */</span>
<span>  #backToTop {</span>
<span>    position: fixed;</span>
<span>    bottom: 30px;</span>

<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>طبقه ۳ (Infrastructure):<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> زیرساخت — دیتابیس، فایل، ایمیل و...<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>طبقه ۴ (Web):<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> ظاهر — چیزهایی که کاربر می‌بینه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>قانون طلایی:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> هر طبقه فقط به طبقه‌های پایین‌تر خودش وابسته‌ست. یعنی Web به Infrastructure، Infrastructure به Application، Application به Domain. هیچ‌وقت برعکس.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>فایل:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>GelatinCapsule.Web/appsettings.json<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-wrapper<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>JSON<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>{</span>
<span>  "ConnectionStrings": {</span>
<span>    "DefaultConnection": "Server=.\\SQL2017;Database=GelatinCapsuleDB;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true"</span>
<span>  },</span>
<span>  "Logging": {</span>
<span>    "LogLevel": {</span>
<span>      "Default": "Information",</span>
<span>      "Microsoft.AspNetCore": "Warning"</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>  },</span>
<span>  "AllowedHosts": "*"</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۴.۲ فایل Program.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Program.cs چیکار می‌کنه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>این فایل، «مغز راه‌انداز» برنامه‌ست. وقتی برنامه اجرا می‌شه، اول از همه این فایل اجرا میشه و همه چیز رو تنظیم می‌کنه:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>به دیتابیس وصل میشه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>سرویس‌ها رو ثبت می‌کنه (Auth, Permission, Cache, ...)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>کوکی و احراز هویت رو تنظیم می‌کنه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Middleware ها رو ترتیب می‌ده<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>در آخر سرور رو راه می‌ندازه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-wrapper<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - Program.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seed;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Web.Authorization;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Web.Services;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span></span>
<span>var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);</span>
<span></span>
<span>// Connection String</span>
<span>var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")</span>
<span>    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Connection string 'DefaultConnection' not found.");</span>
<span></span>
<span>// DbContext</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddDbContext<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>ApplicationDbContext<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(options =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    options.UseSqlServer(connectionString, sql =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        sql.MigrationsAssembly(typeof(ApplicationDbContext).Assembly.FullName);</span>
<span>        sql.EnableRetryOnFailure(3);</span>
<span>    }));</span>
<span></span>
<span>// Cache</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();</span>
<span></span>
<span>// Application Services</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>PasswordHasher<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IAuthService, AuthService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IPermissionService, PermissionService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>ICurrentUserService, CurrentUserService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();</span>
<span></span>
<span>// Cookie Authentication</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddAuthentication(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)</span>
<span>    .AddCookie(options =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        options.LoginPath = "/Account/Login";</span>
<span>        options.LogoutPath = "/Account/Logout";</span>
<span>        options.AccessDeniedPath = "/Account/AccessDenied";</span>
<span>        options.ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromHours(8);</span>
<span>        options.SlidingExpiration = true;</span>
<span>        options.Cookie.Name = "GelatinCapsule.Auth";</span>
<span>        options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;</span>
<span>        options.Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest;</span>
<span>        options.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax;</span>
<span>    });</span>
<span></span>
<span>// Authorization</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddSingleton<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IAuthorizationPolicyProvider, PermissionPolicyProvider<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IAuthorizationHandler, PermissionAuthorizationHandler<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span></span>
<span>// MVC</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddControllersWithViews();</span>
<span></span>
<span>var app = builder.Build();</span>
<span></span>
<span>// Seed Database</span>
<span>using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>ApplicationDbContext<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>    await db.Database.MigrateAsync();</span>
<span>    await ApplicationDbSeeder.SeedAsync(db);</span>
<span>}</span>
<span></span>
<span>// Pipeline</span>
<span>if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    app.UseExceptionHandler("/Home/Error");</span>
<span>    app.UseHsts();</span>
<span>}</span>
<span></span>
<span>app.UseHttpsRedirection();</span>
<span>app.UseStaticFiles();</span>
<span>app.UseRouting();</span>
<span></span>
<span>app.UseAuthentication();</span>
<span>app.UseAuthorization();</span>
<span></span>
<span>app.MapControllerRoute(</span>
<span>    name: "default",</span>
<span>    pattern: "{controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}");</span>
<span></span>
<span>app.Run();<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token comment">&lt;!-- ================= SECTION 5 ================= --&gt;</span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h1</span> <span class="token attr-name">id</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>section-5<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۵. لایه Domain (GelatinCapsule.Domain)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h1</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>لایه Domain چیه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اینجا قلب کسب‌وکاره. کلاس‌هایی که نشون می‌دن «چه چیزهایی توی سیستم وجود دارن». مثلاً «کاربر»، «نقش»، «فرم»، «ماژول» و...<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>هیچ چیزی مربوط به دیتابیس، وب یا UI توی این لایه نیست. فقط خودِ موجودیت‌ها. این باعث میشه کد تمیز و قابل فهم بمونه.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۵.۱ ساختار پوشه‌ها<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>file-tree<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>GelatinCapsule.Domain/</span>
<span>├── Common/</span>
<span>│   └── BaseEntity.cs</span>
<span>├── Entities/</span>
<span>│   └── Security/</span>
<span>│       ├── User.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── Role.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── UserRole.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── Department.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── Module.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── Form.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── Permission.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── RoleFormPermission.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── UserFormPermission.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── UserModuleAccess.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── RoleModuleAccess.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── UserFormDataScope.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── RoleFormDataScope.cs</span>
<span>│       ├── RefreshToken.cs</span>
<span>│       └── AuditLog.cs</span>
<span>└── Enums/</span>
<span>    └── DataScope.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۵.۲ کلاس BaseEntity<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>BaseEntity چیه و چرا داریمش؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>همه‌ی موجودیت‌های ما (User, Role, Form, ...) یه سری فیلد مشترک دارن: <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Id<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>، تاریخ ساخت، تاریخ ویرایش، <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>IsDeleted<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> و...<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>به‌جای این‌که توی همه‌ی کلاس‌ها دوباره این‌ها رو بنویسیم، یه کلاس پایه می‌سازیم و همه ازش ارث می‌برن. این اصل DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) هست.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>IsDeleted چیه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> وقتی کاربر می‌گه «این رکورد رو حذف کن»، ما واقعاً از دیتابیس پاکش نمی‌کنیم. فقط یه علامت می‌زنیم که «حذف شده». اینطوری اگه بعداً فهمید اشتباه کرده، می‌تونیم برگردونیم. به این کار Soft Delete می‌گن.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نقش یعنی گروهی از دسترسی‌ها. مثلاً «مدیر سیستم» یه نقشه که همه‌ی دسترسی‌ها رو داره. «اپراتور تولید» یه نقشه که فقط دسترسی‌های تولید رو داره.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>        <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مجوز یعنی چه کاری کاربر می‌تونه بکنه. مثلاً روی یه فرم خاص:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>➕ <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Create:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> می‌تونه رکورد جدید بسازه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>✏️ <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Edit:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> می‌تونه ویرایش کنه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>🗑️ <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Delete:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> می‌تونه حذف کنه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>🖨️ <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Print:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> می‌تونه چاپ کنه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اینجا منطق کسب‌وکاره. یعنی «چطور کارها انجام بشن». مثلاً:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>وقتی کاربر لاگین می‌کنه، اول رمزش رو چک کن، بعد اگه اشتباه بود تعداد تلاش‌ها رو زیاد کن<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>وقتی کاربر لاگین کرد، دسترسی‌هاش رو محاسبه کن<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نکته مهم: Application به Domain وابسته‌ست ولی به دیتابیس یا وب نه. یعنی اینترفیس‌ها رو تعریف می‌کنه، ولی پیاده‌سازی‌شون توی Infrastructure هست.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>DTO یعنی Data Transfer Object — یه کلاس ساده که اطلاعات رو بین لایه‌ها جابجا می‌کنه. مثلاً LoginResult می‌گه «لاگین موفق بود یا نه، اگه بود اطلاعات کاربر رو بده، اگه نبود پیام خطا بده».<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>public class LoginResult</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public bool Success { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public int? UserId { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public string? Username { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public string? FullName { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public bool MustChangePassword { get; set; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public static LoginResult Ok(int userId, string username, string fullName, bool mustChangePassword)</span>
<span>        =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new()</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            Success = true,</span>
<span>            UserId = userId,</span>
<span>            Username = username,</span>
<span>            FullName = fullName,</span>
<span>            MustChangePassword = mustChangePassword</span>
<span>        };</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public static LoginResult Fail(string message)</span>
<span>        =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new() { Success = false, ErrorMessage = message };</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۶.۶ UserPermissionsDto (قلب سیستم Permission)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>این کلاس چیکار می‌کنه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>وقتی کاربر لاگین کرد، همه‌ی دسترسی‌هاش توی این کلاس نگه داشته میشه:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Permissions:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> مثل "Users:View" یا "Users:Edit" یا "Roles:Create"<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>AccessibleModuleIds:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> به کدوم ماژول‌ها می‌تونه وارد بشه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>DataScopes:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> توی هر فرم، چقدر از داده‌ها رو می‌بینه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>هر بار که کاربر می‌خواد یه صفحه رو ببینه، به این کلاس نگاه می‌کنیم و می‌گیم «آیا این کاربر اجازه داره؟»<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-wrapper<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - UserPermissionsDto.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Permissions.DTOs;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class UserPermissionsDto</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public int UserId { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public HashSet<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>string<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Permissions { get; set; } = new();</span>
<span>    public HashSet<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> AccessibleModuleIds { get; set; } = new();</span>
<span>    public Dictionary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>string, byte<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> DataScopes { get; set; } = new();</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // کلید: "FormCode:PermissionCode" مثل "Users:Edit"</span>
<span>    public bool HasPermission(string formCode, string permissionCode)</span>
<span>        =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Permissions.Contains($"{formCode}:{permissionCode}");</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public bool HasModuleAccess(int moduleId)</span>
<span>        =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> AccessibleModuleIds.Contains(moduleId);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public byte GetDataScope(string formCode)</span>
<span>        =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> DataScopes.TryGetValue(formCode, out var scope) ? scope : (byte)0;</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token comment">&lt;!-- ================= SECTION 7 ================= --&gt;</span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h1</span> <span class="token attr-name">id</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>section-7<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷. لایه Infrastructure (GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h1</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>لایه Infrastructure چیه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اینجا جاییه که «کارهای واقعی» انجام میشه:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span></span>
<span>        builder.HasIndex(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Username).IsUnique().HasFilter("[IsDeleted] = 0");</span>
<span>        builder.HasIndex(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.PersonnelCode);</span>
<span>        builder.HasIndex(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.DepartmentId);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        builder.HasOne(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Department)</span>
<span>               .WithMany(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> d.Users)</span>
<span>               .HasForeignKey(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.DepartmentId)</span>
<span>               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // Global Query Filter</span>
<span>        builder.HasQueryFilter(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> !x.IsDeleted);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷.۴ PasswordHasher<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>PasswordHasher چیکار می‌کنه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>رمز کاربر رو «هش» می‌کنه. یعنی به یه رشته‌ی نامفهوم تبدیل می‌کنه که غیرقابل برگرده. حتی اگه یکی دیتابیس رو ببینه، نمی‌تونه رمز اصلی رو بفهمه.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>PBKDF2 چیه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> یه الگوریتم هشه که 100,000 بار پسورد رو قاطی می‌کنه تا هک کردنش خیلی کند بشه. یعنی اگه یکی بخواد پسورد رو حدس بزنه، هر حدس 100,000 بار محاسبه می‌خواد.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Salt چیه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> یه رشته‌ی تصادفی که به پسورد اضافه میشه تا دو کاربر با پسورد یکسان، هش متفاوت داشته باشن.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-wrapper<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - PasswordHasher.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class PasswordHasher</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly IPasswordHasher<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>string<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _hasher;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public PasswordHasher()</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _hasher = new PasswordHasher<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>string<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(</span>
<span>            new Microsoft.Extensions.Options.OptionsWrapper<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>PasswordHasherOptions<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(</span>
<span>                new PasswordHasherOptions</span>
<span>                {</span>
<span>                    IterationCount = 100_000,</span>
<span>                    CompatibilityMode = PasswordHasherCompatibilityMode.IdentityV3</span>
<span>                }));</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public string Hash(string password)</span>
<span>        =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _hasher.HashPassword(string.Empty, password);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public bool Verify(string hashedPassword, string providedPassword)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var result = _hasher.VerifyHashedPassword(string.Empty, hashedPassword, providedPassword);</span>
<span>        return result == PasswordVerificationResult.Success</span>
<span>            || result == PasswordVerificationResult.SuccessRehashNeeded;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
