<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>AuthService چیکار می‌کنه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مسئول ورود کاربره:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ol</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>کاربر رو از دیتابیس می‌خونه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>چک می‌کنه فعاله یا نه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>چک می‌کنه قفل نشده باشه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>پسورد رو با هش ذخیره‌شده مقایسه می‌کنه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اگه اشتباه بود، تعداد تلاش‌ها رو زیاد می‌کنه و اگه ۵ بار شد، حساب رو ۱۵ دقیقه قفل می‌کنه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اگه درست بود، اطلاعات کاربر رو برمی‌گردونه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>هر دو حالت رو توی AuditLog ذخیره می‌کنه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ol</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-wrapper<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - AuthService.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Auth.DTOs;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Entities.Security;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class AuthService : IAuthService</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private const int MaxFailedAttempts = 5;</span>
<span>    private const int LockoutMinutes = 15;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span>    private readonly PasswordHasher _passwordHasher;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public AuthService(ApplicationDbContext db, PasswordHasher passwordHasher)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>        _passwordHasher = passwordHasher;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>LoginResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> LoginAsync(string username, string password, string? ipAddress, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var user = await _db.Users</span>
<span>            .IgnoreQueryFilters()</span>
<span>            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Username == username <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> !u.IsDeleted, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (user == null)</span>
<span>            return LoginResult.Fail("نام کاربری یا رمز عبور اشتباه است");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!user.IsActive)</span>
<span>            return LoginResult.Fail("حساب کاربری شما غیرفعال است");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (user.IsLockedOut <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> user.LockoutEnd.HasValue <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> user.LockoutEnd.Value <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> DateTime.UtcNow)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var remaining = (int)Math.Ceiling((user.LockoutEnd.Value - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalMinutes);</span>
<span>            return LoginResult.Fail($"حساب شما به دلیل تلاش‌های ناموفق قفل شده است. {remaining} دقیقه دیگر دوباره تلاش کنید");</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!_passwordHasher.Verify(user.PasswordHash, password))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            user.AccessFailedCount++;</span>
<span>            if (user.AccessFailedCount <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>= MaxFailedAttempts)</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                user.IsLockedOut = true;</span>
<span>                user.LockoutEnd = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(LockoutMinutes);</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span></span>
<span>            _db.AuditLogs.Add(new AuditLog</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                UserId = user.Id,</span>
<span>                Username = user.Username,</span>
<span>                Action = "LoginFailed",</span>
<span>                IpAddress = ipAddress,</span>
<span>                IsSuccess = false,</span>
<span>                ErrorMessage = "رمز عبور اشتباه"</span>
<span>            });</span>
<span></span>
<span>            await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>            if (user.IsLockedOut)</span>
<span>                return LoginResult.Fail($"حساب شما به دلیل {MaxFailedAttempts} تلاش ناموفق، {LockoutMinutes} دقیقه قفل شد");</span>
<span></span>
<span>            return LoginResult.Fail("نام کاربری یا رمز عبور اشتباه است");</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        user.AccessFailedCount = 0;</span>
<span>        user.IsLockedOut = false;</span>
<span>        user.LockoutEnd = null;</span>
<span>        user.LastLoginAt = DateTime.UtcNow;</span>
<span>        user.LastLoginIp = ipAddress;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        _db.AuditLogs.Add(new AuditLog</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            UserId = user.Id,</span>
<span>            Username = user.Username,</span>
<span>            Action = "LoginSuccess",</span>
<span>            IpAddress = ipAddress,</span>
<span>            IsSuccess = true</span>
<span>        });</span>
<span></span>
<span>        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return LoginResult.Ok(user.Id, user.Username, user.FullName, user.MustChangePassword);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>bool<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ChangePasswordAsync(int userId, string currentPassword, string newPassword, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var user = await _db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Id == userId, ct);</span>
<span>        if (user == null) return false;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!_passwordHasher.Verify(user.PasswordHash, currentPassword))</span>
<span>            return false;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        user.PasswordHash = _passwordHasher.Hash(newPassword);</span>
<span>        user.MustChangePassword = false;</span>
<span>        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span>        return true;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetUserRoleIdsAsync(int userId, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        return await _db.UserRoles</span>
<span>            .Where(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Select(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.RoleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷.۶ PermissionService (قلب سیستم)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>این مهم‌ترین سرویس پروژه‌ست. کارش اینه که بگه «کاربر X، آیا به فرم Y، عمل Z رو داره؟»<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ol</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نقش‌های کاربر رو می‌خونه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>دسترسی‌های مستقیم کاربر رو می‌خونه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>دسترسی‌های نقش‌های کاربر رو می‌خونه<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اگر Deny صریح کاربر بود → رد<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اگر Grant صریح کاربر بود → قبول<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>اگر در نقش‌ها بود → قبول<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>وگرنه → رد<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ol</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>کش ۵ دقیقه‌ای:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> برای سرعت، نتیجه‌ی این محاسبه ۵ دقیقه توی حافظه می‌مونه. یعنی اگه ۱۰۰ بار پشت سر هم بپرسی، فقط بار اول از دیتابیس می‌خونه.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-wrapper<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - PermissionService.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Permissions.DTOs;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class PermissionService : IPermissionService</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private const string CacheKeyPrefix = "UserPerms_";</span>
<span>    private static readonly TimeSpan CacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span>    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public PermissionService(ApplicationDbContext db, IMemoryCache cache)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>        _cache = cache;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>UserPermissionsDto<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetUserPermissionsAsync(int userId, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var cacheKey = $"{CacheKeyPrefix}{userId}";</span>
<span>        if (_cache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out UserPermissionsDto? cached) <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> cached != null)</span>
<span>            return cached;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var dto = new UserPermissionsDto { UserId = userId };</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var roleIds = await _db.UserRoles</span>
<span>            .Where(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Select(ur =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ur.RoleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var userModuleIds = await _db.UserModuleAccesses</span>
<span>            .Where(uma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> uma.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Select(uma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> uma.ModuleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var roleModuleIds = await _db.RoleModuleAccesses</span>
<span>            .Where(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> roleIds.Contains(rma.RoleId))</span>
<span>            .Select(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rma.ModuleId)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var mid in userModuleIds.Concat(roleModuleIds).Distinct())</span>
<span>            dto.AccessibleModuleIds.Add(mid);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var userPerms = await _db.UserFormPermissions</span>
<span>            .Where(ufp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufp.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Include(ufp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufp.Form)</span>
<span>            .Include(ufp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufp.Permission)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var up in userPerms.Where(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> !x.IsGranted))</span>
<span>            dto.Permissions.Remove($"{up.Form.Code}:{up.Permission.Code}");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var up in userPerms.Where(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.IsGranted))</span>
<span>            dto.Permissions.Add($"{up.Form.Code}:{up.Permission.Code}");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var rolePerms = await _db.RoleFormPermissions</span>
<span>            .Where(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> roleIds.Contains(rfp.RoleId))</span>
<span>            .Include(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.Form)</span>
<span>            .Include(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.Permission)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var rp in rolePerms)</span>
<span>            dto.Permissions.Add($"{rp.Form.Code}:{rp.Permission.Code}");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var userScopes = await _db.UserFormDataScopes</span>
<span>            .Where(ufds =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufds.UserId == userId)</span>
<span>            .Include(ufds =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ufds.Form)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var us in userScopes)</span>
<span>            dto.DataScopes[us.Form.Code] = (byte)us.Scope;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var roleScopes = await _db.RoleFormDataScopes</span>
<span>            .Where(rfds =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> roleIds.Contains(rfds.RoleId))</span>
<span>            .Include(rfds =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfds.Form)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var rs in roleScopes)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var code = rs.Form.Code;</span>
<span>            var scope = (byte)rs.Scope;</span>
<span>            if (!dto.DataScopes.ContainsKey(code) || dto.DataScopes[code] <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span> scope)</span>
<span>                dto.DataScopes[code] = scope;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        _cache.Set(cacheKey, dto, CacheDuration);</span>
<span>        return dto;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>bool<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> HasPermissionAsync(int userId, string formCode, string permissionCode, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var perms = await GetUserPermissionsAsync(userId, ct);</span>
<span>        return perms.HasPermission(formCode, permissionCode);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>bool<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> HasModuleAccessAsync(int userId, int moduleId, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var perms = await GetUserPermissionsAsync(userId, ct);</span>
<span>        return perms.HasModuleAccess(moduleId);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public Task InvalidateCacheAsync(int userId)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _cache.Remove($"{CacheKeyPrefix}{userId}");</span>
<span>        return Task.CompletedTask;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷.۷ ApplicationDbSeeder<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h2</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Seeder چیه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Seeder یه کلاسه که وقتی برنامه برای اولین بار اجرا میشه، داده‌های اولیه رو توی دیتابیس می‌ریزه:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۷ تا Permission (View, Create, Edit, ...)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۵ تا Module (تولید، انبار، کیفیّت، فروش، مدیریت)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۳ تا Form (کاربران، نقش‌ها، دسترسی‌ها)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۱ کاربر admin با رمز Admin@123<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۱ نقش Administrator<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مهم:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> قبل از هر Insert چک می‌کنه اگه قبلاً داده هست، دوباره اضافه نکنه. پس هر بار اجرای برنامه، داده تکراری نمی‌سازه.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-wrapper<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - ApplicationDbSeeder.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Entities.Security;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seed;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public static class ApplicationDbSeeder</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public static async Task SeedAsync(ApplicationDbContext db)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        // 1) Permissions</span>
<span>        if (!await db.Permissions.AnyAsync())</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            db.Permissions.AddRange(</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "View",    DisplayName = "مشاهده",       SortOrder = 1 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Create",  DisplayName = "ایجاد",         SortOrder = 2 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Edit",    DisplayName = "ویرایش",        SortOrder = 3 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Delete",  DisplayName = "حذف",           SortOrder = 4 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Print",   DisplayName = "چاپ",           SortOrder = 5 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Export",  DisplayName = "خروجی اکسل",   SortOrder = 6 },</span>
<span>                new Permission { Code = "Approve", DisplayName = "تایید",         SortOrder = 7 }</span>
<span>            );</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 2) Modules</span>
<span>        if (!await db.Modules.AnyAsync())</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            db.Modules.AddRange(</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "Production", Name = "Production", DisplayName = "تولید",         SortOrder = 1 },</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "Warehouse",  Name = "Warehouse",  DisplayName = "انبار",         SortOrder = 2 },</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "QC",         Name = "QC",         DisplayName = "کنترل کیفیت",   SortOrder = 3 },</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "Sales",      Name = "Sales",      DisplayName = "فروش",         SortOrder = 4 },</span>
<span>                new Module { Code = "Admin",      Name = "Admin",      DisplayName = "مدیریت سیستم",  SortOrder = 99 }</span>
<span>            );</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 3) Forms</span>
<span>        if (!await db.Forms.AnyAsync())</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var adminModule = await db.Modules.FirstAsync(m =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> m.Code == "Admin");</span>
<span></span>
<span>            db.Forms.AddRange(</span>
<span>                new Form { ModuleId = adminModule.Id, Code = "Users",       DisplayName = "مدیریت کاربران",     ControllerName = "Users",       ShowInMenu = true, SortOrder = 1 },</span>
<span>                new Form { ModuleId = adminModule.Id, Code = "Roles",       DisplayName = "مدیریت نقش‌ها",       ControllerName = "Roles",       ShowInMenu = true, SortOrder = 2 },</span>
<span>                new Form { ModuleId = adminModule.Id, Code = "Permissions", DisplayName = "مدیریت دسترسی‌ها",   ControllerName = "Permissions", ShowInMenu = true, SortOrder = 3 }</span>
<span>            );</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 4) Administrator Role</span>
<span>        var adminRole = await db.Roles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(r =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> r.Name == "Administrator");</span>
<span>        if (adminRole == null)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            adminRole = new Role</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                Name = "Administrator",</span>
<span>                DisplayName = "مدیر سیستم",</span>
<span>                Description = "دسترسی کامل به همه بخش‌ها",</span>
<span>                IsSystemRole = true,</span>
<span>                IsActive = true</span>
<span>            };</span>
<span>            db.Roles.Add(adminRole);</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 5) Role Module Access</span>
<span>        if (!await db.RoleModuleAccesses.AnyAsync(rma =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rma.RoleId == adminRole.Id))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var allModules = await db.Modules.ToListAsync();</span>
<span>            foreach (var module in allModules)</span>
<span>                db.RoleModuleAccesses.Add(new RoleModuleAccess { RoleId = adminRole.Id, ModuleId = module.Id });</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 6) Role Form Permissions</span>
<span>        if (!await db.RoleFormPermissions.AnyAsync(rfp =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> rfp.RoleId == adminRole.Id))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var allForms = await db.Forms.ToListAsync();</span>
<span>            var allPermissions = await db.Permissions.ToListAsync();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            foreach (var form in allForms)</span>
<span>                foreach (var perm in allPermissions)</span>
<span>                    db.RoleFormPermissions.Add(new RoleFormPermission</span>
<span>                    {</span>
<span>                        RoleId = adminRole.Id,</span>
<span>                        FormId = form.Id,</span>
<span>                        PermissionId = perm.Id</span>
<span>                    });</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 7) Admin User</span>
<span>        var adminUser = await db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Username == "admin");</span>
<span>        if (adminUser == null)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var hasher = new PasswordHasher();</span>
<span>            adminUser = new User</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                Username = "admin",</span>
<span>                PasswordHash = hasher.Hash("Admin@123"),</span>
<span>                FullName = "مدیر سیستم",</span>
<span>                IsActive = true,</span>
<span>                MustChangePassword = false</span>
<span>            };</span>
<span>            db.Users.Add(adminUser);</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            db.UserRoles.Add(new UserRole { UserId = adminUser.Id, RoleId = adminRole.Id });</span>
<span>            await db.SaveChangesAsync();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Attribute یه برچسبه که بالای کلاس یا متد می‌ذاری و به برنامه می‌گه «قبل از اجرای این، فلان چیز رو چک کن».<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class | AttributeTargets.Method, AllowMultiple = true)]</span>
<span>public class HasPermissionAttribute : AuthorizeAttribute</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public const string PolicyPrefix = "Permission:";</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public HasPermissionAttribute(string formCode, string permissionCode)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        Policy = $"{PolicyPrefix}{formCode}:{permissionCode}";</span>
<span>    }</span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;</span>
<span></span>

<span></span>
<span>public class PermissionAuthorizationHandler : AuthorizationHandler<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>PermissionRequirement<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly IPermissionService _permissionService;</span>
<span>    private readonly ICurrentUserService _currentUser;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public PermissionAuthorizationHandler(</span>

<span>    {</span>

<span>        _currentUser = currentUser;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    protected override async Task HandleRequirementAsync(</span>
<span>        AuthorizationHandlerContext context,</span>
<span>        PermissionRequirement requirement)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (!_currentUser.IsAuthenticated || _currentUser.UserId is null)</span>
<span>            return;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var has = await _permissionService.HasPermissionAsync(</span>
<span>            _currentUser.UserId.Value,</span>
<span>            requirement.FormCode,</span>
<span>            requirement.PermissionCode);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (has)</span>
<span>            context.Succeed(requirement);</span>
<span>    }</span>

PolicyProvider اینو می‌سازه: «یه Policy که نیاز داره کاربر احراز هویت شده باشه و PermissionRequirement داشته باشه».<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>public class PermissionPolicyProvider : IAuthorizationPolicyProvider</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly DefaultAuthorizationPolicyProvider _fallback;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public PermissionPolicyProvider(IOptions<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationOptions<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> options)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _fallback = new DefaultAuthorizationPolicyProvider(options);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationPolicy<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetDefaultPolicyAsync() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _fallback.GetDefaultPolicyAsync();</span>
<span>    public Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationPolicy?<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetFallbackPolicyAsync() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> _fallback.GetFallbackPolicyAsync();</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationPolicy?<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetPolicyAsync(string policyName)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (policyName.StartsWith(HasPermissionAttribute.PolicyPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var parts = policyName[HasPermissionAttribute.PolicyPrefix.Length..].Split(':');</span>
<span>            if (parts.Length == 2)</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                var policy = new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder()</span>
<span>                    .RequireAuthenticatedUser()</span>
<span>                    .AddRequirements(new PermissionRequirement(parts[0], parts[1]))</span>

<span></span>
<span>                return Task.FromResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>AuthorizationPolicy?<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(policy);</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return _fallback.GetPolicyAsync(policyName);</span>
<span>    }</span>

<span>public class CurrentUserService : ICurrentUserService</span>

<span>    public string? Username =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> User?.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.Name);</span>
<span>    public string? FullName =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> User?.FindFirstValue("FullName");</span>
<span>    public bool IsAuthenticated =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public IReadOnlyList<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> RoleIds</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        get</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            if (_roleIds != null) return _roleIds;</span>
<span></span>
<span>            var roleClaims = User?.FindAll("RoleId") ?? Enumerable.Empty<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>Claim<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>            _roleIds = roleClaims</span>
<span>                .Select(c =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> int.TryParse(c.Value, out var id) ? id : 0)</span>
<span>                .Where(id =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> id <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> 0)</span>
<span>                .Distinct()</span>
<span>                .ToList();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            return _roleIds;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>AccountController چیکار می‌کنه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مسئول ورود و خروج:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>GET /Account/Login → نمایش فرم ورود<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>POST /Account/Login → پردازش فرم ورود<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>POST /Account/Logout → خروج<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>GET /Account/AccessDenied → صفحه‌ای که می‌گه «دسترسی نداری»<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>نکته:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> وقتی کاربر لاگین موفقی می‌کنه، ما یه «Claim» براش می‌سازیم. Claim یعنی «یه تکه اطلاعات درباره کاربر». مثل UserId, Username, FullName و RoleIds. این Claimها توی کوکی ذخیره میشن و تا وقتی لاگین هست، همراه کاربر میان.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - AccountController.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using System.Security.Claims;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Web.Models.Account;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Controllers;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class AccountController : Controller</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly IAuthService _authService;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public AccountController(IAuthService authService)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _authService = authService;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public IActionResult Login(string? returnUrl = null)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)</span>
<span>            return RedirectToAction("Index", "Home");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return View(new LoginViewModel { ReturnUrl = returnUrl });</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpPost]</span>
<span>    [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Login(LoginViewModel model, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (!ModelState.IsValid)</span>
<span>            return View(model);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var ipAddress = HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString();</span>
<span>        var result = await _authService.LoginAsync(model.Username, model.Password, ipAddress, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!result.Success)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty, result.ErrorMessage ?? "خطای ناشناخته");</span>
<span>            return View(model);</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var roleIds = await _authService.GetUserRoleIdsAsync(result.UserId!.Value, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var claims = new List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>Claim<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            new(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, result.UserId!.Value.ToString()),</span>
<span>            new(ClaimTypes.Name, result.Username!),</span>
<span>            new("FullName", result.FullName ?? ""),</span>
<span>            new("MustChangePassword", result.MustChangePassword.ToString())</span>
<span>        };</span>
<span></span>
<span>        foreach (var roleId in roleIds)</span>
<span>            claims.Add(new Claim("RoleId", roleId.ToString()));</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var identity = new ClaimsIdentity(claims, CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);</span>
<span>        var principal = new ClaimsPrincipal(identity);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        await HttpContext.SignInAsync(</span>
<span>            CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme,</span>
<span>            principal,</span>
<span>            new AuthenticationProperties</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                IsPersistent = model.RememberMe,</span>
<span>                ExpiresUtc = model.RememberMe</span>
<span>                    ? DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddDays(30)</span>
<span>                    : DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddHours(8)</span>
<span>            });</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (result.MustChangePassword)</span>
<span>            return RedirectToAction("ChangePassword");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.ReturnUrl) <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span> Url.IsLocalUrl(model.ReturnUrl))</span>
<span>            return Redirect(model.ReturnUrl);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return RedirectToAction("Index", "Home");</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpPost]</span>
<span>    [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Logout()</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        await HttpContext.SignOutAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);</span>
<span>        return RedirectToAction("Login");</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public IActionResult AccessDenied() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> View();</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public IActionResult ChangePassword() =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Content("صفحه تغییر رمز — به‌زودی");</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-box<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>simple-title<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>UsersController چیکار می‌کنه؟<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مدیریت کاربران:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Index:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> نمایش لیست کاربران<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Create:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> فرم ساخت کاربر جدید (GET نمایش، POST ذخیره)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>Edit:<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>strong</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> فرم ویرایش کاربر (GET نمایش، POST ذخیره)<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>li</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>ul</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>روی هر Action، یه <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>[HasPermission]<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span> گذاشتیم که نشون می‌ده چه دسترسی‌ای لازمه.<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>p</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-wrapper<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - UsersController.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copyCode(this)<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Entities.Security;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Web.Authorization;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Web.Models.Users;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Controllers;</span>
<span></span>
<span>[HasPermission("Users", "View")]</span>
<span>public class UsersController : Controller</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span>    private readonly PasswordHasher _hasher;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public UsersController(ApplicationDbContext db, PasswordHasher hasher)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>        _hasher = hasher;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Index(CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var users = await _db.Users</span>
<span>            .Include(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Department)</span>
<span>            .OrderBy(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Username)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span>        return View(users);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HasPermission("Users", "Create")]</span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Create(CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var vm = new UserCreateEditViewModel();</span>
<span>        await PopulateDropdownsAsync(vm, ct);</span>
<span>        return View(vm);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HasPermission("Users", "Create")]</span>
<span>    [HttpPost]</span>
<span>    [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Create(UserCreateEditViewModel vm, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (await _db.Users.AnyAsync(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.Username == vm.Username, ct))</span>
<span>            ModelState.AddModelError(nameof(vm.Username), "این نام کاربری قبلاً استفاده شده است");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(vm.Password))</span>
<span>            ModelState.AddModelError(nameof(vm.Password), "رمز عبور الزامی است");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!ModelState.IsValid)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            await PopulateDropdownsAsync(vm, ct);</span>
<span>            return View(vm);</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var user = new User</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            Username = vm.Username.Trim(),</span>
<span>            PasswordHash = _hasher.Hash(vm.Password!),</span>
<span>            FullName = vm.FullName.Trim(),</span>
<span>            PersonnelCode = vm.PersonnelCode?.Trim(),</span>
<span>            NationalCode = vm.NationalCode?.Trim(),</span>
<span>            Email = vm.Email?.Trim(),</span>
<span>            Mobile = vm.Mobile?.Trim(),</span>
<span>            DepartmentId = vm.DepartmentId,</span>
<span>            IsActive = vm.IsActive,</span>
<span>            IsLockedOut = vm.IsLockedOut,</span>
<span>            MustChangePassword = vm.MustChangePassword</span>
<span>        };</span>
<span></span>
<span>        _db.Users.Add(user);</span>
<span>        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (vm.SelectedRoleIds.Any())</span>
<span>        {</span>

<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Edit(UserCreateEditViewModel vm, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>

<span>            .Include(u =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> u.UserRoles)</span>

<span>        user.Username = vm.Username.Trim();</span>

<span>        user.NationalCode = vm.NationalCode?.Trim();</span>

<span>        user.IsLockedOut = vm.IsLockedOut;</span>

<span></span>

<span>        _db.UserRoles.RemoveRange(toRemove);</span>

<span>        foreach (var rid in toAdd)</span>

<span></span>
<span>        vm.AvailableDepartments = await _db.Departments</span>
<span>            .Where(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> d.IsActive)</span>

<span>            .Select(d =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new DepartmentSelectItem { Id = d.Id, Name = d.Name })</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span>    }</span>

<span>    [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Delete(int id, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var role = await _db.Roles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(r =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> r.Id == id, ct);</span>
